exchange.prompt.title: Copy your LODs?
exchange.prompt.message: This world has %s LODs. Copy them to %s so you don't have to explore it again? This can take a few minutes. Areas it already has stay as they are.
exchange.prompt.message.both: This world has LODs from both Distant Horizons and Voxy. Copy them over to fill in what the other one is missing? This can take a few minutes.
exchange.edit.copy.needs_both: Needs both Distant Horizons and Voxy installed.
exchange.edit.none.title: No LODs to copy
exchange.edit.none.message: This world has no Distant Horizons or Voxy LODs yet.
exchange.notice.title: %s is needed
exchange.notice.message: This world has %1$s LODs. To copy them to %2$s, install %1$s next to %2$s for one launch and open the world again.
exchange.progress.title: Copying LODs to %s
exchange.done.title: Copied LODs to %s
exchange.done.message: You can remove %s now if you don't need it anymore.
exchange.failed.title: Couldn't copy the LODs
exchange.failed.message: Something went wrong, the log has the details. Your world opens as usual.
